rules.statement: Where a partition action involves the question of a right of pre-emption under section 14 of the Ordinance, that right should be exercised before the interlocutory decree for partition or sale is entered.
rules.supporting_quote: It seems to us that if an action under the Ordinance involves the question of the right of pre-emption under section 14, that the right should be exercised before the interlocutory decree for partition or sale of the land is entered.
